title: get it toGether
subtitle: men only ~ the leaf is already turned
author: NASIRR "G" MAYO

body.text: men only ~ the leaf is already turned
men only ~ i want to talk to y'all straight for a minute.
if you're not working a job, working on your dreams, or working on a plan, you might not be a contender in the social world. that's not me trying to be harsh. it's just what i've been seeing.

when we're young, a lot of this gets a pass. potential is enough. vibes are enough. "i'm figuring it out" is enough. but at some point it gets harder. it gets more competitive. and the things you were supposed to be building ~ the skills, the savings, the stability, the reputation ~ get more expensive to get the longer you wait.
time doesn't pause while you decide who you want to be.
what she's actually looking at
a lot of women won't want that, and honestly, i get why. it's not always about money. it's about trust.

when a man is STILL trying to get out of survival mode, everything around him feels temporary. she can't fully relax. she can't fully be soft, be supported, be a woman in that relationship, because some part of her is always bracing for the next emergency. she ends up carrying weight that was never hers to carry.

that's not every woman, and it's not every situation. life hits people hard, and survival mode isn't always a choice. but what i've realized is this: the women worth building with can usually tell the difference between a man who's struggling and a man who's stuck.
effort is the signal
some will make it easier for the man who's trying. the one who's putting in effort. the one thinking about his future and the people who'll be in it.

she doesn't need you to have everything already. she needs to see direction. she needs to see that you move the same way when nobody's clapping. that you show up on the boring days. that you have a plan, even if it's early and messy.
a man in motion is a different kind of attractive than a man with a story about what he's gonna do.
the leaf is already turned
a lot of us love the idea of turning over a new leaf. new year, new me. monday i'm starting. after this weekend i'm locking in.
but turning over a new leaf isn't the goal. the leaf is already turned. you already know what you need to do. the decision part is done.
now it's consistent effort. getting better every day. not standing still. not barely moving. not going backwards and calling it a reset.
the work isn't the announcement. the work is the repetition.
toGether or forGet it
so here's where i land, fellas.
get it toGether. for your woman. for your family. for your kids. for the version of you they're going to depend on, whether they're in your life yet or not.
or forGet it forever.
the choice has always been yours. what you do with it every day is the only thing that answers it.
peace G's 💚✊🏾
